mentions.name: AI Vibe Coding Hackathon
mentions.description: An AI vibe coding hackathon organized by Open Community, open to both technical and non-technical participants, with nearly 500 builders, sponsors including ElevenLabs, Daytona, and Nord Security, and around $200,000 in prizes.
mentions.audience: Everyone is welcome to the hackathon, Technical or Non-technical.
mentions.source_excerpt:
We're at Open Community organizing an AI Vibe Coding Hackathon. As of now we got near to 500 builders, big Sponsors like ElevenLabs, Daytona, Nord Security brands and etc. Near to $200,000 in Prizes. 
Everyone is welcome to the hackathon https://vibe.devpost.com, Technical or Non-technical.
